quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to carry the full bin outside for collection"?
quests.question: Empty the Trash
quests.hint: You do this once the bin at home gets completely full.
quests.explanation: That's right! Emptying the trash means carrying a full bag outside.
quests.funFact: Taking out the trash regularly helps keep germs and odors away from your home!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to make the floor neat and free of crumbs"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: A broom with long bristles helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We sweep the floor to clear away dust and crumbs.
quests.funFact: Sweeping right after a meal can help keep crumbs from spreading around the house!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Anytime to scrub away germs with soap and water"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: You do this before meals and after playing outside.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing our hands with soap keeps us healthy.
quests.funFact: Washing your hands for about twenty seconds is the same as singing a short song!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to care for your pet before school starts"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: You do this for an animal friend at home, not for yourself.
quests.explanation: That's right! Feeding a pet means filling its bowl with food and water.
quests.funFact: Feeding a pet at the same time each day helps it feel safe and happy!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to gather tomorrow's books and supplies before lights out"?
quests.question: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow
quests.correctAnswer: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
options: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
quests.hint: This is done the evening before, not the morning of school.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack our school bag the night before so mornings feel calmer.
quests.funFact: A little planning at night can make the whole next morning feel calmer!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to check for cars before crossing the street"?
quests.question: Look Both Ways
quests.hint: This keeps you safe before you step into the street.
quests.explanation: That's right! Looking both ways means checking left and right before crossing safely.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing is one of the most important safety habits to learn!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to reflect on today and share something that made you smile"?
quests.question: Share Something Good About Today
quests.hint: This happens during a cozy chat, right before bedtime.
quests.explanation: Yes! We share something good about today to end the day on a happy note.
quests.funFact: Sharing your day with someone you love is a cozy way to feel close before sleep!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to make your way to school before the bell rings"?
quests.question: Walk to School
options: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
quests.hint: You do this after breakfast, on the way to your classroom.
quests.explanation: That's right! Walking to school is a great way to start the day.
quests.funFact: Walking to school is a fun way to get a little exercise before class begins!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to feel bright, clean, and ready for the day"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: Cool water and a little soap help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our face in the morning to feel fresh and clean.
quests.funFact: Cool water on your face can help you feel awake and alert in the morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to store your bag on a hook before class begins"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: A hook or a cubby is where this bag ends up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We hang up our backpack once we arrive at school.
quests.funFact: Every student's hook or cubby is a special spot just for their own things!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to relax quietly in front of a screen for a bit"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: This is a quiet, relaxing activity, done for just a little while.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watching TV for a little while is a fun way to unwind.
quests.funFact: Watching a favorite show together can be a cozy family activity!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to pair up clean socks after they come out of the wash"?
quests.question: Match Your Socks
quests.hint: You do this after laundry is washed and dried.
quests.explanation: That's right! Matching socks means finding two that look exactly the same.
quests.funFact: Matching socks is like a fun little puzzle you solve with clean laundry!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to give your body fuel before school"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: A bowl of cereal or a piece of toast are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Breakfast is the first meal that helps us feel strong.
quests.funFact: Eating a healthy breakfast can help you feel focused during your first class!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to cover your feet before you head outside"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on our shoes before we head outside for the day.
quests.funFact: Velcro shoes were invented to help little hands get ready all by themselves!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to stand behind your classmates in a tidy line"?
quests.question: Line Up for Class
quests.hint: You stand behind your classmates, one after another, for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We line up for class to walk inside neatly together.
quests.funFact: Lining up in order helps everyone walk safely and calmly into the classroom!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to load up your bag with everything you need"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: You carry this on your back all the way to school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing our backpack means gathering books and supplies for the day.
quests.funFact: Packing your backpack the night before can save you time in a busy morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to move your body and breathe in some fresh air"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: A park, backyard, or playground is a perfect spot for this.
quests.explanation: That's right! Playing outside helps our bodies move and stay strong.
quests.funFact: Sunshine and fresh air can help you feel happy and full of energy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to store your toys neatly before bedtime"?
quests.question: Put Away Your Toys
quests.hint: Each toy has its very own special spot for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy toy shelf makes it easy to find toys again tomorrow.
quests.funFact: A tidy toy shelf can help you find your favorite toy again in no time!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to pick an outfit that matches the weather outside"?
quests.question: Choose Your Clothes
quests.hint: The weather outside can help you decide what to pick.
quests.explanation: Well done! Picking the right outfit can depend on the weather outside.
quests.funFact: Picking your clothes the night before can make your morning much quicker!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to put on your favorite soft sleep shirt"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: You put these on right after your bath.
quests.explanation: That's right! Pajamas are soft, comfy clothes just for sleeping.
quests.funFact: Soft, comfy pajamas can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to get ready for a gentle wake-up call tomorrow"?
quests.question: Set an Alarm
quests.hint: You do this at night, even though it helps your morning.
quests.explanation: Well done! A helpful alarm makes sure we're not late for school.
quests.funFact: A gentle alarm sound can help you wake up feeling calm instead of startled!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to smooth and stack shirts once they're clean and dry"?
quests.question: Fold the Laundry
quests.hint: Shirts, socks, and pants all get neatly stacked for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Neatly folded clothes are easy to put away in a drawer.
quests.funFact: Neatly folded clothes take up less space in a drawer or closet!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning when your alarm rings and your day begins"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: An alarm clock often helps remind your body it's time for this.
quests.explanation: Well done! Every morning begins the moment we wake up.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Midday to fill your tummy halfway through your busy day"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: A sandwich, some fruit, or a lunchbox are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Lunch gives us energy for the rest of our busy day.
quests.funFact: Eating a balanced lunch can help you stay focused for your afternoon classes!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to play with bubbles and get nice and clean"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: Warm water, soap, and maybe some bubbles are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a bath to wash away the day's dirt and feel clean.
quests.funFact: Warm bath water can help your body relax and feel calm before bedtime!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to make your playroom neat again after playtime"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: You do this after playtime is finished, before dinner or bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cleaning up toys means putting playthings back where they belong.
quests.funFact: A tidy playroom gives you more space to run, build, and play!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to warm your feet before you get dressed further"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: These go on your feet, right before your shoes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on socks to keep our feet warm before our shoes go on.
quests.funFact: Cozy socks can help keep your whole body feeling warm on a chilly day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to make your room dark and cozy for sleeping"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: This is one of the very last things you do before sleep.
quests.explanation: Well done! A dark, quiet room helps us fall asleep more easily.
quests.funFact: A dark room can help your body understand that it's time to sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to loosen up your body before a busy day"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: This wakes up muscles that were resting all night.
quests.explanation: That's right! Stretching helps our body feel ready to move after sleeping.
quests.funFact: Even animals like cats and dogs love a good stretch after a nap!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to choose food to bring along for lunchtime"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: A lunchbox or paper bag holds the food for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack a lunch in the morning so we have food ready for midday.
quests.funFact: Packing a colorful lunch with fruits and veggies can make lunchtime extra fun!
